capabilities: : Convert Markdown tasks to planning board
: Reorder tasks via drag and drop
intentEvidence: Plan Panel is an Obsidian plugin for turning Markdown task lists into a lightweight planning board.
problem: Users lack a visual, structured way to organize and prioritize standard Markdown task lists based on urgency and importance.
summary: Plan Panel converts Markdown task lists into a lightweight planning board, classifying tasks into Eisenhower quadrants for daily prioritization.
